items.title: JVM Diagnostics & Troubleshooting in Production
items.description: A practical guide to JVM monitoring and diagnostics tools (jcmd, jstack, jmap, jstat) and troubleshooting CPU spikes, deadlocks, and memory leaks.

items.title: Network Troubleshooting & Diagnostic Tools
items.description: Practical guide to tcpdump, Wireshark, netstat, ss, nmap, curl, openssl, dig, traceroute and how to diagnose every layer of the network stack.
